source.snippet: I have been on the 20x Max plan of Claude Code for a while now, however since last week something changed and I seem to have been getting lots and lots of those 529 errors. My workflow hasn't changed, same level of concurrency as usual, did they change their limits? (6 points, 4 comments, 2026-06-22)

problem_statement: Paying Claude Code subscribers on high-tier plans (20x Max) are experiencing unexpected 529 'overloaded' rate-limit errors with no transparency about limit changes, breaking professional AI-assisted coding workflows.
target_segment: Professional developers and teams paying for high-tier Claude Code / Anthropic API plans who rely on consistent throughput for daily coding workflows.
notes: Buyer signal is explicit: poster is on a paid '20x Max' plan (~$200/mo tier). Pain is workflow disruption from opaque rate-limit changes. Opportunity angles: (1) a proxy/queue layer that smooths 529s across multiple provider keys, (2) a monitoring/alerting dashboard for LLM API quota health, (3) a multi-provider failover service. Competitors like LiteLLM exist but are self-hosted and complex. A managed version with good UX could command $20–100/mo per team.
